title: Australians resort to ‘cooking their own petrol’ as fuel prices surge past $3
summary: Aussies are freaking out as fuel prices hit $3.50+ a litre in regional areas, with diesel pushing past $4. A Sunshine Coast guy went viral with a "solution" to cooking their own petrol—basically everyone's joking about how desperate the situation's gotten. The fuel crisis kicked off thanks to Middle Eastern conflict blocking shipping routes, causing supply chaos and major panic-buying. Regional areas got hit hardest with actual shortages. The government's pushing work-from-home as relief and DoorDash is helping delivery workers with fuel subsidies. It's a full meltdown—the cost of living just got way more painful.
